pattern: if {f:Filter} would deal damage to a permanent or player , it deals double that damage instead

examples.text: If a Knight you control would deal damage to a permanent or player, it deals double that damage instead.
If an artifact creature you control would deal damage to a permanent or player, it deals double that damage instead.

counterExamples: If a Knight you control would deal damage to a permanent or player, it deals triple that damage instead.
If a Knight you control would deal damage to a creature, it deals double that damage instead.
If a Knight an opponent controls would deal damage to a permanent or player this turn, it deals double that damage instead.

pattern: if {f:Filter} would deal damage to a permanent or player , it deals that much damage plus {n:Qty} instead

examples.text: If a Goblin, Rat, Elf, or Wizard you control would deal damage to a permanent or player, it deals that much damage plus 2 instead.
If a Dragon you control would deal damage to a permanent or player, it deals that much damage plus 3 instead.

counterExamples: If a Dragon you control would deal damage to a permanent or player, it deals that much damage minus 1 instead.
If a Dragon you control would deal damage to a player, it deals that much damage plus 3 instead.
If a Dragon you control would deal damage to a permanent or player, it deals that much damage plus 3 for each Dragon you control instead.

If one or more counters would be put on a permanent you control, twice that many of each of those kinds of counters are put on it instead.
